title: Crew Training - Apollo XI - MSC
description: Suited Apollo XI Crewmen Armstrong and Aldrin training in Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP) deployment in Building 5, as Astronaut Mike Collins trains in the Building 20 Centrifuge.       S-Band Antenna (31148 thru 31165, 31178 thru 31179)    MSC, HOUSTON, TX
